th: ภาวะ azotemia (BUN/Cr สูง)

sections.html: Azotemia = Elevation of BUN and Cr

sub.h: Step 1: Exclude out of proportion BUN or Cr elevation
sub.html:
Out of proportion BUN ↑Out of proportion Cr ↑
1. Urea generation ↑
  • Catabolic state
  • Incr. protein intake
  • Aminoacid infusion
  • GI bleeding
2. Steroid therapy or tetracycline		1. Creatinine generation ↑
  • Rhabdomyolysis
2. Creatinine secretion ↓
  • Cimetidine
  • Trimethoprim
3. Jaffe reaction
  • ketone/ cephalosporin

sub.h: Step 2: แยกว่าเป็น Chronic kidney disease หรือ acute kidney injury
sub.html:
CKD definition: abnormal kidney structure or function > 3 months

Feature of CKD

  1. Elevation of Cr > 3 months
  2. PE: uremic skin
  3. Lab: anemia
  4. Imaging of kidney: bilateral small size kidney
  5. X-ray bone: renal osteodystrophy

AKI definition: as any of following

  • SCr ≥ 0.3 mg/dl in 48 hrs
  • SCr ≥ 1.5 times baseline in 7 days
  • Urine < 0.5 ml/kg/hr for 6 hours

ลายมือในหัวข้อ 4.1 เขียนเกณฑ์ AKI เป็น Cr ≥ 1.5–1.9x ใน 48 hrs และ Cr ≥ 0.3 mg/dL ใน 7 days — เวลาสลับกับที่พิมพ์ในหน้านี้

AKI = acute increase in creatinine by at least 50%

CKD = decreased kidney function (eGFR < 60 ml/min/1.73 m²) persistent over at least 3 months

  • Pre-Renal (evidence of renovascular disease): atheroemboli, renal artery stenosis, drugs, chronic hypoperfusion
  • Renal (abnormal urinalysis: proteinuria/pyuria)
    • Tubular (family history, ultrasound): polycystic kidney disease, medullary cystic disease, nephronophthisis
    • Vascular (other small vessel disease): atherosclerosis
    • Glomerular (proteinuria): diabetes, hypertension
    • Interstitial (sterile pyuria, WBC casts, eosinophiluria): drugs (NSAIDs, analgesics), infections (chronic pyelonephritis), immune (sarcoid, Sjögren), multiple myeloma, hyperoxaluria, hypercalcemia, hyperphosphatemia
  • Post-Renal (obstruction/hydronephrosis on U/S): reflux nephropathy, benign prostatic hyperplasia, constipation, prostate cancer

sub.h: Step 3: แยกสาเหตุของ AKI — Pre renal / Intrinsic renal / Post renal
sub.html:
• Pre renal
    • Hypovolemia
    • Decrease effective circulatory volume: Liver failure, Cardiac failure
    • Decrease cardiac output
    • Impair renal autoregulation: NSAIDs, ACEI/ARB, Cisplatin
  • Intrinsic renal → ดูต่อหน้าถัดไป (Intrinsic renal causes of AKI)
  • Post renal obstruction: Full bladder, Hydronephrosis → ดูต่อ Urinary tract obstruction

Pre-Renal (FeNa < 1%, bland urine sediment)

  • Renal hypoperfusion: hepatorenal syndromes, drugs, emboli
  • Systemic hypotension: shock

Post-Renal (obstruction/hydronephrosis on U/S)

  • Benign prostatic hyperplasia
  • Constipation
  • Prostate cancer
  • Urolithiasis

Renal (FeNa > 2%) → urinalysis and CBC to separate tubular / vascular / glomerular / interstitial (see Intrinsic renal causes)

sections.h: Intrinsic renal causes of acute kidney injury
sections.html:
ตำแหน่งสาเหตุ
Vessel — Large vesselRenal artery: Emboli, dissection · Vasculitis
Renal vein: Thrombosis
Abdominal compartment syndrome
Vessel — Small vesselGN/Vasculitis · TTP/HUS · DIC · Malignant HT · Atheroemboli · Calcineurin inhibitor
GlomerulusAcute GN · RPGN
Tubule — TubularIschemic ATN
Nephrotoxic ATN — Endogenous: Rhabdomyolysis, Hemolysis · Exogenous: Contrast, Aminoglycoside
Tubule — Intratubular obstructionEndogenous: Myeloma protein, Uric acid, Cellular debris
Exogenous: Acyclovir, Methotrexate
Interstitium (Mnemonic “A+3I”)Allergic: Penicillin, Rifam
Infection: Pyelonephritis
Infiltration: Lymphoma
Inflammation: Sjogren, sepsis
  • Tubular: acute tubular necrosis (epithelial cell casts): ischemia (severe hypotension), toxins (contrast, aminoglycosides, chemotherapy), pigments · tubular obstruction: cast nephropathy (multiple myeloma), urate crystals, calcium oxalate (ethylene glycol)
  • Vascular (thrombocytopenia and schistocytosis on CBC): TTP/HUS: Shiga-like toxin (E. coli), drugs, HIV, malignancy
  • Glomerular (RBC casts, dysmorphic RBCs): rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis: anti-GBM antibodies, immune-complex deposition (IgA, post-strep, lupus), pauci-immune (Wegener's)
  • Interstitial (sterile pyuria, eosinophiluria): acute interstitial nephritis: drugs (NSAIDs, Abx, allopurinol, PPI), infections (CMV, strep, legionella), immune (lupus, sarcoid, Sjögren)
